words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 10 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 9 (open, price, submit).
Wait until the round's bid end time has passed.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts the new bid.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the round counts the new bid.
